summary_en: The caller initiated the call to inquire about the consultation fee and operating hours. The agent provided the details, stating the fee is ₹300 and the business is open Monday through Saturday from 10 AM to 8 PM. The caller, identifying himself as Kiran, expressed interest and asked for his inquiry to be noted. The agent confirmed the note and asked for the reason for the visit along with a preferred day and time. The caller declined to provide further details, stating that was all for now, and thanked the agent. The call ended with the agent thanking the caller.
